The 3400 Series Universal Testing Machines from Instron - USA have capabilities ranging from 500 N to 300 kN and are designed to meet all force testing requirements.
Get in touch now
3400 Series Universal Testing SystemsPlay
Video Credit: Instron - USA
Thanks to Instron's patent-pending Operator Protect system architecture, the 3400 Series is smarter, easier, and safer than ever. These systems are compatible with a wide range of grips and fixtures from Instron's comprehensive accessory catalog. They are designed to conduct tensile, puncture, flex, friction, peel, compression, shear, and other tests.
Available models — 0.025 N (2.5 gf) to 300 kN force capacities
Low-force testing systems
500 N, 1 kN, 2 kN, and 5 kN force capacities
The 3400 single-column series has a capacity of up to 5 kN and is available in regular and additional height configurations for low-force applications.
Single-column testing machine. Image Credit: Instron - USA
Mid-range testing systems
5 kN, 10 kN, 30 kN, and 50 kN force capacities
The 3400 dual-column table model series has a capacity of up to 50 kN and is available in regular and extra height configurations for applications requiring higher force.
Dual-column testing system. Image Credit: Instron - USA
High-force testing systems
100 and 300 kN force capacities
The 3400 Series floor models provide up to 300 kN capacity available in short base and tall base options.
Floor model testing system. Image Credit: Instron - USA
Simpler — Powered by Bluehill® Universal
The Operator Dashboard, which consists of large touchpoints to make the user experience smarter and simpler, is made possible by simple workflows and icons that make it easy to train new or experienced users, expedite operator training, and enable users to start testing even faster than before. Bluehill® Universal was built from the ground up for touch interaction.
Bluehill® Universal Software for Next Generation Static Materials TestingPlay
Video Credit: Instron - USA
Get in touch now
QuickTest
QuickTest allows users to run their test in seconds after entering a few simple parameters for speedy results.
Pre-loaded templates
An extensive library of pre-configured methods for some of the most widely used ISO, ASTM, and EN standards is included in Bluehill® Universal. Modules tailored to the user’s testing application contain the approaches.
Bluehill Universal materials testing software. Image Credit: Instron - USA
Exporting tools
Step-by-step instructions can guide users through the testing process, ensuring their tests are straightforward, repeatable, and error-free. Prompts can be customized with images and text.
Safer — Safety without sacrificing throughput
Operator protect
The 3400 Series is built around Instron’s patent-pending Operator Protect architecture. A smart workflow improves operator and equipment safety by monitoring system status from setup to test completion.
Built-in safety coaching
The 3400 system clearly instructs users on when it is safe to enter the test space and when they should avoid it.
Smart-close air kit
Lower grip-closing pressure and reduced speed during the installation phase of a test reduce the risk of finger pinching caused by pneumatic grips.
Operator protect. Image Credit: Instron - USA
All-new operator panel
System controls are now more accessible than ever, thanks to the 3400 Series’ newly improved operator panel. Ergonomics and throughput are enhanced by jogging the crosshead, starting and stopping tests, and returning to the initial position directly from the instrument.
Operator panel. Image Credit: Instron - USA
1. Variable speed jog
In the installation mode, the system will automatically adjust to a safe speed that allows an operator to operate in the test area.
2. Status at a glance
In Bluehill® Universal, indicator lights and associated Safety Coaching messages can be used to track the system’s status.
3. Virtual interlock
Instron’s patent-pending system design restricts the instrument's movement to avoid the crosshead moving unintentionally.
Smarter — Protecting user’s investment
Collision mitigation
If force is sensed during a jog or upon return, the crosshead can be stopped to minimize damage to sensitive specimens and equipment.
3400 Series internal components. Image Credit: Instron - USA
Load cell overload protection
When the load cell reaches its maximum capacity, the 3400 Series systems automatically stop. This prevents harm to the system, load cell, and accessories.
Built to last
The 3400 Series, powered by maintenance-free brushless AC servomotors, is designed to last. For added durability, all of Instron’s electromechanical systems include guidance columns and preloaded ballscrews.
